extracted.name: The Best Dry-Roasted Chickpea Recipe
extracted.description: Use this basic dry-roasted chickpea recipe to create a tasty, crunchy baked snack customized with your favorite flavors and seasonings.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Spread garbanzo beans in a baking dish and pat dry with a paper towel.
Bake in the preheated oven, stirring halfway through, about 22 minutes. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Return to the baking dish.
Continue baking chickpeas, stirring halfway through, until golden and dry on the outside, about 22 minutes more.
